parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The keyword for a fuzzy search of asset information, such as table names.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The number of items to return on each page. Default: 20. Maximum: 100.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The sort field. Valid values: `confidence` and `entityId`. The default value is `confidence`.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: `asc` for ascending order and `desc` for descending order. The default value is `desc`.
